proposed_comments.title: Close the single-line resource entry
proposed_comments.body:
### Close the single-line resource entry

**Severity:** `high`

`PasteAsSingleLine` is never closed before `FixSpellingAndGrammar`, so this `.resw` is not well-formed XML and resource generation cannot consume it. Close each entry and remove the stray blank line so the Advanced Paste resource build succeeds.

```suggestion
  <data name="PasteAsSingleLine" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Paste as single line</value>
  </data>
  <data name="FixSpellingAndGrammar" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Fix spelling and grammar</value>
  </data>
  <data name="CoachingExplanationTitle.Text" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>What was changed and why</value>
  </data>
```

proposed_comments.title: Keep the dashboard action order consistent
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the dashboard action order consistent

**Severity:** `low`

The dashboard appends Single Line after JSON, while the Settings page, OOBE page, and Advanced Paste action list use Plain Text → Single Line → Markdown → JSON. Move the Single Line block before the Markdown block so users see the same built-in action order on every surface. This needs a small block move rather than a safe one-click suggestion because the destination is outside the added dashboard hunk.
